explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/382: if the largest prime dividing ∏_{u≤m≤v} m appears with exponent ≥ 2, is v - u = v^{o(1)}? Open; it follows from Cramér. The statement reads this as: for every ε > 0 and all large v, every such pair has v - u ≤ v^ε, the standard uniform reading. Faithful.
